Playbook.name: Linux — Attempt to Disable Syslog Service - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: The syslog/rsyslog/journald service was stopped. RECOVERED: JCB auditd SERVICE_STOP records the stopped unit name (auditd.log.unit) - proven live. Triage: attacker stopping logging to go dark, or legitimate service maintenance?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Stopping syslog blinds host logging, a defense-evasion step.

Assets.AssetType: Linux servers (core banking, app, DB - INTDOM)

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: JCB Linux auditd does NOT audit execve (no EXECVE records, event.action:exec never occurs) or file paths. It DOES capture: USER_CMD (commands run via sudo, WITH process.args + auditd.log.AUID/UID user), SERVICE_STOP/START (auditd.log.unit), NETFILTER_CFG (firewall config), package events. These queries use those real records.

COVERAGE IS PARTIAL: USER_CMD captures only sudo-invoked commands - it misses actions taken when already root and non-sudo execution. Full coverage requires enabling auditd execve+file auditing (or Elastic Defend / ingesting the already-installed MDE-for-Linux device telemetry).

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the logging-service stop is defense evasion or legitimate maintenance.

Step.name: Logging-service stop events on the host (SERVICE_STOP unit)
Step.Purpose: auditd SERVICE_STOP records which unit stopped - filter for the logging services.
Step.Query: FROM logs-auditd.log-* | WHERE event.action == "stopped-service" AND host.name == "$hostname" AND auditd.log.unit RLIKE "(?i).*(syslog|rsyslog|journald|systemd-journal|auditd).*" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, auditd.log.unit, auditd.log.AUID, host.name | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: rsyslog/journald/auditd stopped, especially by a non-admin AUID or amid other suspicious activity, is defense evasion. A stop during a documented maintenance/patch window is benign.

Step.name: Was the service stop via a sudo command
Step.Purpose: A sudo systemctl stop of the logging service links the stop to a user.
Step.Query: FROM logs-auditd.log-* | WHERE auditd.log.record_type == "USER_CMD" AND host.name == "$hostname" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | EVAL cmd = MV_CONCAT(process.args, " ") | WHERE cmd RLIKE "(?i).*(stop|disable|mask|kill).*(syslog|rsyslog|journald|auditd).*" | KEEP @timestamp, auditd.log.AUID, cmd | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 10
Step.AnalystNotes: A sudo systemctl stop/disable/mask of the logging service identifies the user - correlate with INV-01.

Node.Condition: The logging service was stopped/disabled by an unexpected user or amid suspicious activity.
Node.Result: True Positive (Logging Disabled / Defense Evasion - investigate host)

Node.Condition: A logging-service restart during documented maintenance/patching.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-SVC-STOP, INV-02-SVC-STOP-CMD to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the maintenance; close as benign_activity.

TruePositive.Definition: An attacker stopping logging to go dark.

Indicators.Item: Logging service stopped by an unexpected user.

SOCAction.Item: Restore logging; inspect the host for what happened while blind; open IR.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm which logging service stopped and whether it restarted.
If evasion, restore logging and inspect the host.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Restore logging; inspect the host for the blind window; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enable auditd execve auditing for full command coverage; redesign the detection to use SERVICE_STOP/USER_CMD; alert on logging-service stops.

QualityChecks.Check: RECOVERED via SERVICE_STOP (auditd.log.unit) - proven live. The paired EQL detection (event.action:exec) cannot fire; redesign it to key on stopped-service for the logging units, or on USER_CMD.
Partial: catches service-manager stops and sudo stop commands; a direct kill by root may be missed.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Logging restored; blind window inspected; host contained.
